# Third-party page template attribution

## Current template (2026-10-12)

Academic Project Page Template by Eliahu Horwitz:
https://github.com/eliahuhorwitz/Academic-project-page-template/tree/original-version

Branch: `original-version` (the classic template used by QuantVSR).
Commit: `b2e6e09010f0feb72b115fe9cc6bcb9d1277047c`.

Files copied without modification:

- `template.css` from `static/css/index.css`.
- `bulma.min.css` from `static/css/bulma.min.css`.
- `fontawesome.all.min.js` from `static/js/fontawesome.all.min.js`.

`index.html` uses the original title/author/resource block, Bulma containers,
white sections, light-gray abstract, and footer structure. Research content is
Hihaze's existing content. The two custom image carousels, collapsed result
table, image dialog, and citation copy action remain; their component styles
are in `../style.css`. A mobile title-size rule is the only typography adjustment.
The template's Google Sans / Noto Sans / Castoro stylesheet is linked directly.

Unused sample video, poster, author URLs, and paper content are not included.
No analytics, Adobe PDF embed, or unused carousel/slider JavaScript is loaded.

The template derives from Nerfies: https://nerfies.github.io/ . Its HTML and
styling are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Attribution remains in the footer.
Research/dataset image assets retain their respective rights.

Bulma by Jeremy Thomas is MIT licensed; see `BULMA-LICENSE.txt` and the notice
retained in `bulma.min.css`.

Font Awesome Free 5.15.1 by Fonticons, Inc. retains its license header in the JS:
https://fontawesome.com/license/free (icons: CC BY 4.0, fonts: SIL OFL 1.1,
code: MIT).

## Earlier adaptation

The 2026-10-06 page used QuantVSR's CSS followed by custom layout and gradient
background overrides. Those stylesheet layers were replaced on 2026-10-12.
QuantVSR reference: https://bowenchai.github.io/QuantVSR/ .
The two independently implemented image carousels were originally inspired by
FlashVSR: https://zhuang2002.github.io/FlashVSR/ .
